changelog: **Roster feeds can deprovision, behind four safety valves (#1966):** with `RosterFeed.deprovision` on, a mentee the feed no longer mentions is stamped `User.rosterAbsentSince` and, on a successful run at least `deprovisionGraceDays` (1) UTC days later, deactivated: `isActive=false`, `sessionsValidFrom` stamped **and** remembered devices revoked, `deactivatedBy = roster:<feedId>`. Nothing is ever deleted or anonymised. Valves, all checked before the first write: a row floor (`minRowCount`) and a deactivation ceiling (`maxDeactivatePercent`, 10%, counted on everyone the feed is offboarding) abort the run as `ABORTED_SAFETY` with zero writes; the last active admin and SSO break-glass accounts are never deactivated; a run with any unreadable row deprovisions nobody. A person back in the feed is reactivated only if a feed switched them off (`/api/users/[id]` now records the admin in `deactivatedBy`). Aborted and deactivating runs mail `ALERT_EMAIL_TO` and the org's `supportEmail`. Rules pure in `src/lib/rosterDeprovisionRule.ts`; reviewer-facing doc `docs/roster-feeds.md`.
